decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted and numbered P2075.01A, P2075.02A, P2075.02.01A, P2075.03B, P2075.04B, P2075.03.01A, Received 29 September 2011, Hepworth Acoustics Limited Noise Assessment, Received 3 October 2011  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The cumulative noise level from all plant and equipment shall not exceed 44dBLAeq at the nearest residential window at 3a Prince of Wales Terrace.

Condition : 4 - Activities relating to the collection of refuse and recyclables and the tipping of empty bottles into external receptacles shall only take place between 07.00 and 23.00 Monday to Saturday and 09.00 and 20.00 on Sundays and Bank Holidays.
description: Erection of single storey rear extension and bin store to the premises with an external staircase to provide access to the roof and installation of a kitchen extractor system on the rear roof.
